Under 4 Labour Codes (Wages, IR, Social Security, OSH&WC), CLRA 1970, EPF & MP Act 1952, ESI Act 1948, POSH Act 2013, enforcement has evolved from periodic paperwork collection to real-time statutory scrutiny. Regulatory agencies now leverage integrated digital portals to detect filing anomalies, attendance register mismatches, and contractor payment gaps instantaneously.

Let's review a real-world case study: An automotive supplier with 6 manufacturing plants faced repeated inspection warnings due to scattered registers. By deploying a centralized automated digital register architecture and conducting pre-audit mock drills, they achieved 100% compliance scores within 60 days, cutting reporting overhead by 60%.

To implement this in your organization, follow our 6-phase roadmap: Discovery and gap assessment, risk prioritization, policy harmonization, digital register deployment, supervisory training, and continuous automated surveillance.
